description: This file defines theming functions for a frontend project, including a base theme 'Ocean Professional' with colors, typography, radius, and elevation settings, as well as utility functions for generating categorical color palettes and mapping categories to colors.

methods.name: getOceanTheme()
methods.description: Returns the Ocean Professional base theme tokens including colors, typography, radius, and elevation settings.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette(count)
methods.description: Generates a deterministic color palette seeded by Ocean theme colors, suitable for categorical data visualization with contrast and distinction.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap(categories)
methods.description: Maps category names to distinct colors from the categorical palette, maintaining stable assignment order.
